Thanks — this reads as a sensible way to break the work up, and I can see each of the things I care about has its own chunk of work: saving with the details filled in, the search with tags and phrases, the read-later queue, my formatted notes, and the bulk actions with archive-and-restore and confirmed deletion. And thank you for confirming the two things I flagged — that I can always save a link even when a page is slow or won't cooperate, and that empty screens get a friendly, useful message instead of nothing.

Starting with saving, automatic details, and duplicate handling as the first milestone makes sense to me — that's the heart of it, and I'd rather see that working before the rest is layered on.

Go ahead and begin implementation. I'll be looking to see the app actually working when you're ready to show it.
